notes.features: Available stored simulation variables; not replacements for the formal objective8/joint12 panels.
notes.forecast_days: 14 observed days minus 7-day horizon and 2-day confirmation = 5 common forecast days, independent of outcome.
notes.reference_and_events: All 60 reference people and all 30 calibration event people in the existing simulation; these are availability checks, not a clinical power calculation.
notes.discovery: Existing three-condition, person-bootstrap and max-statistic permutation criteria; retain no-module results without relaxing thresholds.
notes.warning_policy: Existing research setting: two consecutive scores, seven-day cooldown and one false alarm per 30 evaluable days. Requires future prospective validation.
notes.learning_rates: Compare the prior low-rate configuration with the repository base-training rate using the new text validation split; head rate is five times encoder rate.
notes.test: Historical authored test people were previously inspected; independent of new fitting, but not a fresh human gold or prospective test.
notes.success: No arbitrary accuracy target is asserted. Report intervals and compare DNB with simple methods, including failure to find a qualified module.
